verdict.rationale: Turso's docs explicitly describe provisioning one isolated SQLite database per user/agent/tenant, token-scoping and tearing it down via the Platform API, and marketing claims support for spinning up thousands or millions of such databases programmatically, backed by CLI and API tooling for full lifecycle management. Community feedback corroborates ease of use and low cost for hosted Turso deployments, though it does not specifically test fleet-scale provisioning. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of managing thousands of databases at scale, and concrete cost benchmarks for large fleets.
